name: Logs Explorer: Loki/Graylog-style log viewer (search, facets, histogram, virtual list, live tail)
description:
## Problem

`client/src/components/LogViewer.vue` (registered as the **Logs** app, `log-viewer` in `client/src/config/apps.js:278`) is the raw application-log viewer and it does not scale:

- `$storex.logs.fetchLogs(tailSize)` pulls the **whole log file body** (`GET /api/system/logs/{name}?log_size=N`) into memory, parsed as a plain `string[]`.
- Every line is rendered unconditionally with `v-html` — no virtualization, so a few thousand lines freeze the tab. `v-html` on log content is also an injection risk.
- Search is client-side `String.replace` + `document.querySelectorAll('.log-match')`, so it can only ever see the lines already in the DOM.
- No levels, no timestamps, no facets, no time range, no pagination, no context lines, no live tail.
- `api/codx/junior/log_parser.py` already parses `[timestamp] LEVEL [module:line] content` + continuation lines + `Request ... - 12.3 ms` + `Profiler: {...}`, but **nothing exposes it** — the frontend never uses it.

Note: `client/src/components/logs/*` (`LogsAnalyzerDashboard.vue`, `LogsFilterBar.vue`, `LogsTable.vue`, `LogsLiveMetrics.vue`, `LogsAnalytics.vue`, `LogEntryDetail.vue`) is a *different, working* feature — the **AI request/response log** analyzer backed by `api/codx/junior/api/logs.py` + `ai/raw_log_reader.py`. Do not break it.

## Goal

A Grafana-Explore / Graylog-style **Log Explorer** for application logs: server-side parsing and filtering, level facets with counts, a clickable time histogram, a virtualized result list, a detail/context panel, a small query language and live tail.

## Frozen API contract (`/api/logs/explorer/*`)

- `GET /sources` → `{ sources: [{ id, name, path, size_bytes, mtime, kind, entries_estimate }] }`
- `GET /query?source&q&start&end&level&page&page_size&order&histogram_buckets` →
  `{ entries: [{ id, timestamp, ts_ms, level, logger, module, line, message, fields, continuation_lines, source, raw_preview }], total, page, page_size, has_more, histogram: [{ ts_ms, total, by_level }], facets: { level: [{value,count}], logger: [...], module: [...] }, stats: { scanned_lines, scanned_bytes, matched, duration_ms, truncated } }`
- `GET /entry/{id}?source=` → full entry (raw text + parsed fields)
- `GET /context/{id}?source=&before=10&after=10` → `{ entries: [...] }`
- `GET /tail?source=&since_cursor=` → `{ cursor, entries: [...] }` (poll based)

Query language (AND-joined terms): `free text`, `"exact phrase"`, `level=error,warn`, `logger~"regex"`, `field=value`, `field~"regex"`, negation with a leading `-`.

## Acceptance

- pytest green for the new parser/query/API tests.
- The Logs app renders the new explorer; no `v-html` on log content; only the visible window is in the DOM.
- Filtering, faceting, histogram zoom, pagination, context and live tail all driven by the new endpoints.
- Old `/api/system/logs` endpoints keep working.

## Delivery report — Logs Explorer (run 65f0019b, all 4 steps done, 3.98/60 cxjcoins)

### Backend — `/api/logs/explorer/*` (new `api/codx/junior/logs/`)
- `models.py` (LogEntry, LogLevel + normalisation), `parsers.py` (lazy `iter_entries()` streaming over an open file handle — never `readlines()`, continuation/traceback attachment, JSON-logger records, request/profiler fields reused from `log_parser.EXTRACTORS`, ids `"<source>#<line index>"`), `query.py` (free text, `"exact phrase"`, `level=error,warn`, `logger~"re"`, `field=value`, `field~"re"`, `-` negation, invalid regex → substring fallback), `sources.py` + `service.py` (bounded scan, histogram, facets, stats/truncated, entry, context, tail cursor), `api/log_explorer.py` (the 5 frozen routes, auto-discovered).
- `api/docs/log-explorer.md`: architecture, response contract, query language, param tables, curl examples, env tunables.
- **99 pytest tests pass** (`pytest tests/logs -q`, run twice in the API container); router proven loaded (`Registered router from log_explorer`).

### Frontend — `client/src/components/logs/explorer/`
- `LogExplorer.vue` (container: toolbar, query bar, facets rail, histogram, list, detail drawer, status bar, `/` `j` `k` `Enter` `Esc`).
- `LogVirtualList.vue` (dependency-free scroller: visible window + overscan, prefix-sum offsets, per-item measured heights, binary-search lookup, `scroll-end` append).
- `LogEntryRow.vue` (plain-text segments rendered as spans — **no `v-html` anywhere in the folder**), `LogQueryBar.vue`, `LogLevelFacets.vue`, `LogHistogram.vue` (click-to-zoom), `LogDetailPanel.vue`.
- `composables/useLogExplorer.js` (all state, stale-response guard, 300 ms debounce, 2 s tail polling) and `api/modules/logs.js` `API.logs.explorer.*`.
- `appComponentsMap.js`: `log-viewer` → `LogExplorer.vue`; legacy `LogViewer.vue` kept for the `metrics` app; `/api/system/logs` + `store/logs.js` untouched.

### Evidence
- `npm run build-only` in the workspace container → **exit 0, 5206 modules**.
- No `v-html` in the 8 new SFCs; AI logs dashboard files unchanged.

### To try it
1. `docker_compose_restart service=api` — **required**: the running process predates the new module.
2. Open **Logs**, pick a source, try `timeout`, `level=error,warn`, `logger~"chat_.*"`, `-"health check"`, click a histogram bar to zoom, toggle live tail.

### Known gaps
- Repo-wide `npm run build` still exits 1 on **pre-existing** `vue-tsc` errors (vite.config.ts moduleResolution, main.ts missing .d.ts, CodxJuniorLogo `$storex`, router/index.ts) — none from the new files.
- Atlas index is empty for api/ + client/ (`project_health`), hence discovery had to walk the tree; separate task.
- Working tree also holds unrelated `calendar` changes from another run — don't commit them together.
- Live tail is poll-based; huge files return `truncated: true` within the env-tunable scan window.
